chunks: When among them the great wretch arose,
ai.seo_question: Who is the 'great wretch' that arises in Surah Ash-Shams?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the emergence of the Dajjal or a specific tyrant, emphasizing the transition from latent evil to active manifestation. It underscores the concept of 'Ashqaha' (the most wretched) as a figure whose rise signals a period of intense tribulation and divine reckoning.
